summary_plain: Moves about 27 arcseconds per hour across 16 images over 21.2 hours. Not yet checked against JPL's catalog of known asteroids and comets.

orbit.reported_orbit: The arc is too short to fix one orbit, so this is the most circular of the 1260 sampled orbits that fit the detections; the clones show the range.

known_object.not_checked_reason: JPL Horizons did not answer for 1442 Corvina (1937 YF), the closest known object (about 36″ away in JPL's quick search).

scores.definition: Rule-based ranking score in [0, 1]: motion_consistency x snr x (1 - artifact_likelihood). It orders candidates for review. It is not a probability.

history.change: linked 16 detections over 4 visits from 2025-11-08 to 2025-11-09

disclaimer: An unmatched candidate may be an imaging artifact, a measurement error, or an object missing from the catalogs we checked. This is not a discovery claim.
